profile_text.body:
Credo AI was founded in 2020. The company describes itself as the creator of the AI governance category and the trusted leader in AI governance. Its platform is built to help enterprises discover AI, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. Credo AI says the platform uses a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context and is supported by forward-deployed experts. It also describes an Agent Governance capability that provides a registry for every agent, purpose-built agentic risk and controls, and governance.

Credo AI's product is an AI governance and risk management platform. It is purpose-built for AI governance and is noted for a clean interface and fast deployment. The platform includes pre-built policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards, which the company says were written by people involved in ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. Credo AI also offers GAIA, a Govern AI Assistant that is generally available in the platform, and says it has native integrations across existing stacks, with 300+ integrations.

The company's site includes testimonials attributed to Mastercard and IBM, and references a collaboration with IBM on Compliance Accelerators. The available data does not list litigation or MCP servers for Credo AI.
